notes.title: Harem in Another World v0.9 development update
notes.notes: [p]​Hi All,  [/p][p][/p][p]Just thought I'd let you know how the development of the v0.9 update is coming along. I post devlogs every two weeks online but thought I would drop a wider, summary devlog here to keep you guys informed. The current release date is set as the 23rd September! That might move a week either side but expect it around that time. [/p][p]This next update is shaping up to be a bumper one, with around twice as much new content as the last update! New scenes, new main story, new relationship quests, new outfits, new upgrades. There's a whole load of great stuff being added, I'm excited for you all to play it. [/p][p]First off, thank you to everyone who participated in the feedback survey, it's been very useful to me and it was great hearing all of your lovely feedback! The survey is still live if you haven't participated yet, just check the previous news post. There are lots of QoL improvements coming out off the back of that, I thought I'd shout out a couple of them here: [/p][list][*][p]The vast majority of players sped up combat, so I'm changing the default speed to "fast". You will still be able to slow it down to the original speed or sped it up to Ultra fast.[/p][/*][*][p]I'll be adding an option to change the colour of your banners and your castle guards after purchasing them, so you're not stuck with one colour. [/p][/*][*][p]I'll be adding a signpost near Halden so it's clearer that you can walk along the beach to get there, as some people got lost at that section[/p][/*][*][p]I've removed the option to be able to equip things to the girls. You couldn't actually put anything on them anyway, but the menu still existed  [/p][/*][/list][p]This is by no means all of the changes, just some that came from the survey and can be easily put into a bullet point. At the same time I did a full run through of the game and ended up with 14 full pages of notes! So there's been a lot of small improvements and tune up taking place across the game. [/p][p]I don't want to get too deep into the censorship discussion, my assumption is if you are reading this you already know about Steam and Itch's crackdown caused by mastercard and visa. Plus the UK requiring ID checks to look at adult content, just a big old shit show all round. Harem in Another World has not been banned from either platform which is good, but it is still de-listed from itch. Which in short terms means my income just got cut by around 50%. This doesn't stop me working, but it makes the day to day of paying artists and animators a lot more difficult.  [/p][p]If you have any questions, or if you just want to chat, you can drop into the discord server here: https://discord.gg/6M2C7Pupvz  [/p][p]Catch you in the next update!  [/p][p]Love  [/p][p]Jong[/p]

notes.title: Harem in Another World v0.8 progress update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Thought I would update you all on the progress made for the latest update. Expected release date is end of August to mid September. I post regular updates, sketches and polls on Discord and patreon. I thought I could put together a quick summary post to go here to keep you all informed about some of the upcoming changes. So here's a non exhaustive summary of the key changes discussed in the devlogs since the last major release.

[list]
[*] Madeline won the content poll so is getting a number of new scenes in her personal story line in the next update. 
[*] The next update is going to be mainly focused on the girls individual stories and them interacting with each other rather than the main quest.
[*] Currently around 12 new scenes planned, even more than the last update! Not all of these are spicy some are more character focused
[*] I'm implementing an outfit change system, so you can adjust how your girls will dress at home and when they follow you around (If they agree to wear the outfit). This changes the in game sprite and the character image when talking to them. There's also going to be special scenes for certain outfits.
[*] Boss battle system has been improved so it looks better, is easier to see and should be more responsive.
[*] The next update will have the first impregnation/pregnancy scene included. This is for one of the side characters not any of the main girls yet.
[*] Overhaul of a lot of the early sprite artwork like Ruth so it better matches how her character looks.
[*] Large number of minor changes to the intro and first part of the game to improve polish.
[*] There was a poll about adding "Moan" sound effects to the game, which had an overwhelming 95% vote yes. So I'm adding in sound effects to all new and existing scenes. 
[*] A new teleport tab has been added to the nomad camp to reduce the amount of running back and forth in the desert in the early game.
[*] The key for saving Orla no longer requires the upgraded boat to reach it
[*] Completing the bank quest now has much lower requirements and unlocks a walk in safe in your house with a pile of money that grows and shrinks depending on you cash level.
[/list]

That's a brief overview of the main points, if you want a more in depth read the devlogs are all publicly available :) .

Catch you in the next update!

Jong

notes.title: Harem in Another World 1 year retrospective
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

The 1st of November marks the one year anniversary of the initial release of Harem in Another World!  I thought to mark the occasion I’d write a more long form post chatting about the general development of the game and how it started.

I first started work on HIAW in 2020 about two years before the initial release. It was a project I picked up during Covid and was mostly to pass the time. I dropped in and out of working on it over the next year and a half. Learning the engine better, making mods and just generally skilling up. After a year and a half of dipping in and out I decided to turn my focus directly on the game. Combine all the loose thread and ideas and pull it together to make a single vision.

The original working title was “An Adventure through Time”. You would have time-travelled to ancient Rome and need to find your way home. After working with that idea for a while I was finding the realism too restricting, so I started adding more fantasy elements and eventually dropped the time travel setup to instead travelling to a different world. Rome became Roma and I started adding Goblins and Ghosts and lots of fun stuff.

The setup wasn’t the only thing that changed during the initial development. Your childhood friend Ruth was originally going to be your childhood friend Dan! As I got more into the story I found having another guy in your party messed with the Harem vibes, and why waste art commissioning a guy when it could instead be a hot girl. So Dan’s character was changed to Ruth’s, in the initial version there was a glitch where his original sprite was still visible in places.

It took me a while to figure out what the art was going to be for the game. I toyed around with the idea of 3d models for a while but decided against it in the end. Although 3d has the benefits of being faster, easier and cheaper, I felt 2d made the game feel more unique, and if you were to see an image out of context you would be able to tell where its from.

v0.1 was probably 90% complete before I brought the lead artist Starli on board. I had tried a couple of different artists first looking for the right one but we didn’t gel that well, I think if your working on a long term project like this having a good relationship between your team members is key. Starli has been great to work with and I can’t now picture the game with any other art.

The release of v0.1 was a mixed bag. On the one hand I got some nice positive feedback, and some good constructive criticism. On the other hand I had a particularly nasty guy who went out of his way to review bomb me across multiple accounts and tell me to KMS. So you know, ups and downs :)

It’s true what they say about criticism, the bad ones stick in your mind far deeper than the good ones. Still, that initial abuse has for the most part been an isolated incident  and hearing your positive feedback in reviews and on discord makes my day brighter.

And here we are now. A year later, released in steam early access and v0.6 in development. Thank you for your ongoing support and for being with me on this journey

Love

Jong
